rows.grounds: compound of sūrya and tīrtha in accusative
optative third singular active of bhū

items.question: Which tīrthas lie to the east and west of that place?
premises: East of that place is sūrya-tīrtha.
West of that place is vāruṇa.
items.inference: The verse prescribes sūrya-tīrtha east and vāruṇa west of the referenced place.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasya is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: To its east is the sūrya tīrtha, and to its west is the vāruṇa tīrtha.
